hero.title: How was your day, <accent>really?</accent>
hero.intro: Moodify is a calm place to check in with yourself. Log your mood in a few seconds, tick off the habits that matter to you, and discover what makes your good days good.

steps.title: A minute a day is enough
steps.intro: No journaling marathon, no pressure. Just a short, honest check-in.

checkIn.title: Check in with yourself
checkIn.text: Pick how the day felt on a scale from 0 to 10. It takes a few seconds.

habits.title: Tick off your habits
habits.text: Mark the small things you did for yourself: a walk, a few pages, an early night.

patterns.title: See your patterns
patterns.text: Over the weeks, the chart and heatmap show what lifts your mood.

insights.title: Watch your mood find its rhythm
insights.intro: Every check-in adds a point. Over time you see your ups and downs, and which habits come with your better days. Here with a few months of sample data.

moodCheckIn.title: Mood check-in
moodCheckIn.text: A calm 0–10 scale with one emoji per step. Quick enough for every evening.

moodOverTime.title: Mood over time
moodOverTime.text: Your daily mood and its 7-day average, from the last week to the whole year.

ownHabits.title: Your own habits
ownHabits.text: Add the habits you care about and tick them off next to your mood.

heatmap.title: Habit heatmap
heatmap.text: A year of habits at a glance: the darker the day, the more you did.

streaks.title: Streaks
streaks.text: See how many days in a row you kept each habit, without pressure.

lookBack.title: Look back anytime
lookBack.text: Open any past day to remember how it went or fill in a day you missed.

cta.title: Start with today
cta.text: It takes less than a minute. After a few weeks you'll start to see which habits lift your mood.

header.checkInToday: Take a moment to check in with yourself.
